name: Gumshoe
description: A man in his fifties, a rain-soaked future-noir private detective with a cybernetic eye, who sings slow smoky trip-hop.
build: A lean adult build of ordinary proportions: medium shoulders, a straight torso and arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Weathered olive skin, a long straight nose, heavy dark-grey stubble along the jaw, a dark-brown natural character-left eye, and a round glowing amber cybernetic character-right eye set in a bold dark-steel ring.
hair: Short swept-back dark-grey hair, damp. A wide-brimmed charcoal fedora with a black band sits level on the head.
outfit: A knee-length belted tan trench coat, double-breasted, wide lapels and a matching tan belt tied at the waist, open below the belt, sleeves ending at the wrists so both hands are bare; a charcoal shirt and a wide dark-red tie beneath; charcoal straight-legged trousers; black leather shoes. The coat is darkened with rain on the shoulders.
performance_style: Weight on the character-left leg, the character-right knee loose. Both arms hang at his sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, fingers fully visible beside the coat. Head level, a tired half-lidded look.
location: A rain-swept city street at night, seen from wet black pavement running to the bottom of the frame: a dark brick wall, a lit amber streetlamp, glowing cyan wordless neon shapes and falling rain.
recognition_cues: a knee-length belted tan trench coat
a glowing amber cybernetic character-right eye in a dark-steel ring

sing.intent: Trip-hop vocal loop: slow, the mic in the character-right hand rises to the mouth, the character-left hand drifts open at chest height, the head tips down under the brim on a low line, then lifts and he returns to the loose stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief startle at a siren: the shoulders tighten, the head turns aside and both open hands lift slightly, then he settles. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn a shoulder forward and raise the character-left forearm before the chest, then hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: walk in slowly, tip the fedora brim with the character-right hand, then settle into the loose stance with both hands open at his sides.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: tip the fedora back with the character-right hand, the cyber eye flaring bright, and hold a small knowing grin.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: the shoulders slump, both open hands hang limp and his head drops so the brim shades the face, the cyber eye dimmed. He holds a standing, weary finish. He remains standing on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
